workPasses: all 8 pages to 60–80% with existing organized assets
run structural linter and reference visual diff after meaningful batches; fix largest structural distance first
reference-distance comparison and anti-AI structural correction
precisely specified final generation batch only if needed
hardRules: live Figma page role wins over stale page-number assumptions
organized Drive library is the first asset-search surface
inspect actual pixels before final asset selection
DUMMY is layout-only
REFERENCE is not production art
replaceable people and scenery photos may be low-resolution proxies during layout and do not block ASSET_FIRST_80 solely on PPI
proxy photos remain masked, replaceable, explicitly non-final, and receive final resolution/provenance/crop QA after replacement
final title/logo/decor/icon/badge/frame/background graphic assets receive strict resolution and visual QA during current production
REAL_PHOTO promoted to final requires subject and pixel verification
GENERATED final graphic requires visual and resolution QA
body and changeable copy stay native editable text
replaceable images stay independently masked/clipped
frame artwork stays separate from photo source
normal-text internal contrast target is at least 4.5:1
large-display internal contrast target is at least 3:1
do not communicate meaning by color alone
preferred effective resolution for final graphics and final photography is 300 ppi or higher
below 250 effective ppi is not print-ready for final promoted assets
do not flatten whole pages
do not make one page 100% while the rest are empty
reference-match pass requires score 80 or higher and no fatal AI-look tell
do not assign a flattering reference score to a PREPROD_SKELETON
after each meaningful page batch run the live structural AI-look linter and screenshot reference visual diff before micro-polish
if reference match is weak, fix hierarchy/crop-scale/image-weight/composition/editorial-cluster before adding decoration or micro-spacing
adjacent pages must not repeat the same dominant composition verb, hero position, photo-frame rhythm and dominant color by default
normalized page-signature similarity >=85% between different PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE page jobs normally requires structural divergence
